title: Camp Tent Headcover
excerpt:
GGNC headcovers up-cycled from three 1950s canvas camp tents, sourced across America.

No two are the same, some have off-white cotton braided camp rope, some have brass grommets, some have patches sewn on over the years to repair holes, all different parts of the tent.

  • One-of-a-kind items

  • Faded olive green canvas

  • 70 years of natural patina.

  • Driver covers - Feature original brass grommets, snap buttons, tabs and off-white braided camp rope .

  • Fairway Woods - each one a unique pattern of stitching and tent, some have patches, do not feature grommets or rope.

  • Felt interior with elastic interior ring to hold head in place

  • Driver cover fits all drivers up to 460cc

  • Fairway wood cover fits everything from Mini-Driver to Hybrid

title: Vintage Floral Patchwork Quilt - Valuables Pouch

Constructed from an assortment of small-scale floral cotton calico prints in red, navy, pink and cream, the original quilt was pieced together using leftover and repurposed fabrics.

Each pouch preserves a different section of the original quilt, making every piece entirely one of a kind.

1/40 Edition.

  • Vintage American quilt, circa 1950s–1970s

  • Assorted floral cotton calico patchwork

  • Up-cycled and handmade in New York City

  • Metal zip closure

  • Metal clip attachment

  • GGNC Authentic One-of-a-Kind Item label

  • Fully lined with heavyweight bull denim

  • Each pouch is completely unique

title: Nature Club - Catskills Trout Hat
excerpt:
The Catskill Mountains in upstate New York hold a special place in the heart of Gumtree Golf & Nature Club and the heart of American fly fishing as a whole. Known as the birthplace of the dry fly scene since the 1890s when Theodore Gordon began creating fly patterns tailored to the unique rivers of the Catskills such as Beaverkill, Willowemoc and Neversink.

Our Catskills Trout Hat features a healthy rainbow trout found in these waters, surrounded by our Nature Club New York City type on a stone 6-panel. Embroidered in New York city

  • Mid profile six panel cap, curved peak

  • Light weight

  • 100% cotton

  • Adjustable fastener with metal clasp

  • One size fits all

title: GGNC Field Trip 003 – The Catskill Mountains, New York
excerpt:
Join us in the woods of the Catskill Mountains, New York from August 16–18, 2026 for three days of unforgetable golf & nature.

Day One - Kicks off around 2pm

We gather in the Catskills for arrival and check-in before handing over exclusive GGNC & lululemon duffle bags, packed with everything you'll need for the days ahead.

Our trip begins with an opening ceremony led by a local flora and fauna expert, introducing the landscapes, wildlife and quiet details that make this corner of New York unlike anywhere else.

From there we head to Swan Country Club, where tree-lined fairways and rolling mountain views ease us into the weekend. As the afternoon fades, we arrive at our private woodland camp, a collection of modern cabins and Airstreams tucked deep into the forest. The evening unfolds around an open fire with a long dinner, good drinks and conversation before slowing things down with guided mindfulness and stargazing beneath the Catskills canopy.

Day Two

Coffee from the GUMTREE(COFFEE) truck. Breakfast together.

Our morning mindful movement session is powered by lululemon, taking place among the trees before the day begins.

From there we visit one of the Catskills' hidden golfing treasures: a beautifully preserved Donald Ross nine-hole course that is super approachable and charming.

After a private lunch, we head into the mountains for an afternoon round at Windham Mountain Golf Club, where elevated tees and sweeping valley views offer an entirely different side of Catskills golf.

The day finishes away from the course with a short forest hike leading to a secluded freshwater swimming hole, the perfect place to cool off before returning to camp.

As night falls, we gather for a private long-table dinner cooked over open fire in the woods. Under a canopy of stars, we'll close the evening with a special performance from Cameron Avery of Tame Impala, surrounded by nothing but forest.

Day Three - Wraps around 2pm, earlier if you just want to play 9 and skip lunch

Coffee. Breakfast. One last slow morning together.

Our final round takes us to the historic Woodstock Country Club, a classic Catskills course that has welcomed generations of golfers for 100 years beneath the surrounding mountains.

We'll finish with lunch and drinks in Woodstock before one last drink, a few hugs, and the journey home.

Your Ticket Includes

• Two nights accommodation in our remote Catskills camp - personal accommodations in either a cabin or airstream with AC, TV etc. (no shared rooms)

• 18 Holes at Swan Country Club

• 18 Holes at Woodstock Country Club

• 18 Holes at Windham Mountain Club

• 9 Holes at Rip Van Winkle CC

• Guided hike and swim in freshwater river swimming hole.

• Exclusive GGNC x lululemon duffle bag & curated gear worth over $1000

• Private morning mindfulness moment each day (yoga, mediation etc) run by lululemon ambassadors

• Breakfast & lunch every day

• Drinks & snacks on the course

• Private dinner & drinks on arrival night

• Private long-table dinner under the stars by local chef on night 2 - cooked over an open fire

• Private performance by Cameron Avery of Tame Impala in our amphitheater in the woods.

• Transport between golf and camp locations throughout the trip if needed.

What You Handle

• Travel to and from basecamp in the Catskills

• Personal golf gear (club rentals can be arranged)

TRANSPORT GUIDE

By Car: Approximately 2 hours from New York City. You'd fly into LaGuardia or JFK.
We can help organize car pooling with other guest coming from NYC or we will have limited spots in the GGNC van first come first served.

By Train from NYC: Take Amtrak from NYC to Hudson, then a 30-minute rideshare to camp. (we can arrange pickup if enough people choose train)

By Air (non-NYC airports): Fly into Albany (1 hour away), Stewart/Newburgh (1 hour), Newark (2 hours)

title: Elements Single Origin GUMTREE (COFFEE)
excerpt:
Our current single origin coffee comes from the Nyamasheke growing region in South Central Lake Kivu. It’s high up in the mountains around 2000 meters above sea level and features green, lushly-forested mountainsides. Bordering Congo on the west, it offers a range of altitudes all the way up to 2200 masl and beyond. It’s also home to the biodiverse Nyungwe forest, where rainfall ranges from 1300 to 1400 millimeters per year. The soil is volcanic and rich. It’s right above Lake Kivu and the view looks down on the watershed, all the way down to the lake itself. Kanzu is on the downslope right below this forest, at an extremely high elevation, and we’ve always seen how climate plays a huge role in the flavor development of these coffees.

The cherries here ripen a lot later than most of the country and are frequently one of the last harvests of the season.

Made for pour overs on the windowsill & percolators humming in the background.

  • Whole Beans

  • 12oz/340g

  • Sustainably Sourced from real farmer relationships who are paid Beyond Fair-Trade wages.

  • Roasted in Brooklyn, New York

title: Vintage New York State Outdoor License – Ball Markers
excerpt:
New York was one of the first states in the U.S. to formalize wildlife conservation. By the late 19th century, over-hunting and unregulated fishing had pushed many species toward collapse.

In response the state created what became the New York State Conservation Department in 1911 and from the late 1920s through the early 1940s they issued these metal license pins to residents who hunted, fished, and trapped its public lands and waters.

Each year brought a new color. Each button carried a serial number. Each one was worn openly, pinned to a jacket, a wool coat, a shirt pocket. Proof that you belonged out there and that you agreed to take care of what you touched.

These are each a rare piece of New York nature and outdoor history, representing the birth of regulated outdoor recreation.

Each piece has been altered to lay flat as a ball marker and features GGNC hand stamped on the reverse side. Comes in a Nature Club dust pouch.

Approximately 1.75” in diameter.

PLEASE NOTE: These products have been well-loved and hand-picked from across America. They may include wear, distress, marks/light stains and other minor signs of a previous life well lived that adds to the natural patina and character of these one-of-a-kind pieces. Please treat with love.

title: Dimple & Divot x GGNC – Species Brush
excerpt:
These Gumtree Golf & Nature x Dimple & Divot premium golf brushes are made in the US and carved from three different species of American trees. All brushes feature a nickel trigger snap and tonal paracord to match the natural wood tones.

BRUSH 1
The sugar maple (Acer saccharum) stands as one of nature’s quiet masterpieces. Native to the forests of eastern North America, it’s best known for two gifts, the slow drip of its sap each spring, and the unmatched blaze of color it brings each autumn. Its wood, dense and fine-grained, has long been shaped into instruments, clubs, tables and now this golf brush, things meant to last. 

BRUSH 2
The American sycamore (Platanus occidentalis) is found along riverbanks and old fairways across the eastern states, it wears its history on its bar, peeling layers of gray, cream, and green over its long life. In summer, its broad leaves cast some must needed shade on the course and in winter, its pale trunk gleams against the rest of the woods, impossible to miss. It’s signature grain is evident in this golf brush.

BRUSH 3
The shagbark hickory (Carya ovata) is a tree that feels both rugged and refined. The kind you notice not for its perfection, but for its personality. Its tall, straight trunk is wrapped in strips of curling bark that peel away like old parchment, revealing a silvery smoothness beneath. Found across the eastern woodlands, it’s a tree of deep roots and slow reward,  its nuts feeding wildlife and its wood prized for warmth, smoke, and strength.

title: NYC Vintage Subway Token Golf Ball Marker Set
excerpt:
Beyond being a perfect substitute for a ball marker, NYC Subway tokens are such a great symbol of NYC -combining ingenuity and practicality. First introduced in 1953 the tokens were then redesigned through the years as either the price of a fare went up or the city wanted to commemorate a milestone with a limited edition token. Every historical design is featured in this collection - from a few of the very first tokens of the 50s/60s, the "bull's eye" look of the 1980s, the pentagon-cut variant in the '90s as well as the celebratory limited edition token released in 1979.

  • Circa - 1952-1995

  • Two coins per set

  • Protective Linen drawstring bag with NY branches print

Known as the birthplace of the dry fly scene since the 1890s when Theodore Gordon began creating fly patterns tailored to the unique rivers of the Catskills such as Beaverkill, Willowemoc and Neversink.

Our Catskills Trout Tote features a healthy rainbow trout found in these waters, surrounded by our Nature Club New York City type. Embroidered in New York city

Each of our one-of-a-kind GGNC Rugby Polos features a unique vintage Italian Micro mosiac Flower Brooch (circa 1940-1970) hand picked from across Italy. As well as an embroidered GGNC logo on the left chest.

Micro mosaic was born in Italy the 18th century, originally adorning Roman floors and chapel ceilings, over the centuries the form of art shrunk down to include small pieces of jewelry, with the artwork meticulously created with tiny shards of glass or enamel.

Please select your preferred brooch from the drop down menu then add shirt size separately below.

  • 12 only

  • Vintage brooch sourced from Italy (circa 1940-1970)

  • Monochrome Gumtree Golf & Nature Club logo on chest

This garment features well-loved vintage brooches that have been hand-picked from across Italy. They include some wear, distress, marks and other minor signs of a previous life well lived that adds to the natural patina and character of these one-of-a-kind pieces. excerpt:
Our handmade set of two artisanal soaps has been meticulously crafted using aromatic essential oils, fresh herbs, botanicals and dried flowers, designed to transport you to two distinct golf experiences in different corners of the world. The base of the soap is made from the milk of goats that roam free in the the Texas Hill Country. Perfect for daily use on all skin types.

Links

This olive oil-based detox soap is designed to invoke the feeling of a long round of golf in the sand-belt of Victoria, Australia. It’s formulated with essential oils of eucalyptus, mandarin, and grapefruit to cleanse, plus chlorophyll for rejuvenation. Like a late afternoon round with a warm north westerly breeze blowing offshore.

Parkland

This goat’s milk soap is designed to invoke the feeling of a long round of golf in upstate New York. It’s formulated with essential oils of patchouli, cedar, and hay to cleanse, plus walnut hulls for exfoliation. A high-lather soap, perfect for body or hair.

title: GGNC Field Trip – Sonoran Desert, Arizona
excerpt:
Join us in the Sonoran Desert outside Phoenix Arizona this December for three days of unforgettable golf and nature. 

December 14th - 16th 2025

Day 1 kicks off with an afternoon welcome and talk from “Bear”, a leader from the Yavapi Tribal Council teaching us about the land we’ll be spending the next three days fishing, golfing and eating upon. We’ll then enjoy some welcome drinks and gift bags with exclusive Gumtree Golf & Nature Club gear you’ll be able to put to good use on the trip. From there we’ll move a hilltop overlooking the Sonoran Desert sunset where we’ll have local fly fishing experts give you a fly fishing lesson right on the We-Ko-Pa fairways - getting you freshened up for the water the next day. Those of you who want to hit the range can with a private range session, while others can sit back listen to the sounds of the desert with the crackling of the open fire and enjoy drinks and dinner under the stars. 

The next morning we tee off on our first round of golf amongst the rich desert ecosystem of We-Ko-Pa. We’ll play alongside the majestic saguaro preserve where we’ll also find typical desert shrubs and plants such as creosote bush, palo verde, mesquite trees and cholla cactus. 

From there we’ll relocate to the nearby Salt River where our guides from the evening before will take each foursome out on the river for a guided afternoon on the water where we’ll have our targets on Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) and the Sonoran Sucker (Catostomus insignis) -  A native species, often overlooked, but known to inhabit the river and provide a super fun time if lucky enough to snag one. 

We’ll end the day with a long table family style dinner under the stars where we’ll eat local produce and proteins prepared by local chefs while we drink and share stories of the birdies and fish that got away and the one or two that we were lucky enough to nail. 

The final day we’ll have breakfast then hit our second and last 18 holes of the trip. The We-Ko-Pa saguaro course. Winding through the rolling hills of cactus we’ll be on the lookout for local wildlife like Roadrunners, Javelinas & Coyotes.

Your ticket includes:

  • Two nights accommodation in a King room at We-Ko-Pa golf resort

  • Two rounds of golf at the We-Ko-Pa golf resort in peak AZ weather! We’ll be playing both the Cholla course and the Saguaro Course

  • Drinks & Dinner under the stars on Sunday

  • Private range session on Sunday afternoon

  • Fly Fishing lesson by expert local guides on the fairway the evening before you fish

  • How to tie a fly class for those who want to dial in! 

  • Transport from the course through the desert to the fishing location. (about 30 min each way)

  • Lunch by the river. 

  • All the fishing gear you’ll need for the day, rods, flys, waders etc.

  • Guided fly fishing expedition on majestic the Salt River of the Sonoran Desert, each 4-some gets their own expert guide to shepherd you through an amazing afternoon on the water. 

  • Private group dinner under the stars by the fire with a custom menu prepared and cooked by one of Phoenix best chefs.

  • A bag of exclusive GGNC gear including hats, shirts, balls and well as custom flies made for fishing the AZ waters

What you need to do:
Get yourself to and from Phoenix AZ and to and from WeKoPa (about a 25 mins)
Bring whatever golf/fishing/birding gear you want. (We’ll have fishing gear for everyone included and there are golf clubs we can help arrange for you at the course if you’d prefer not to bring yours.)

See you in the desert!

title: GGNC Field Trip 002 – St. George & Zion, Utah
excerpt:
Join us in the high desert of Southern Utah from March 29–31, 2026 for three days of golf, nature and dark sky.

Day One

We meet in St. George with arrival and check-in before handing over exclusive GGNC & ON duffle bags worth over $1000 in value and packed with pieces built for red rock terrain.

From there we tee it up at Sand Hollow Golf Club’s Links Course, dramatic fairways cut through sandstone dunes and desert scrub, with views stretching toward toward Zion.

After golf, we transport to our remote camp on the edge of Zion National Park. As the light softens against the canyon walls, we settle into BBQ, drinks and stories around the fire.

Later, we move to soak at Zion Hot Springs under the open sky.

Day Two

Coffee at camp. Breakfast together.

Our morning mobility session is powered by ON. Each guest will receive a pair of unreleased ON trail sneakers, along with other curated ON gear, we’ll be one of the first in the world to field-test this new silhouette.

Led by an expert from ON, we’ll move through guided mobility and meditation before taking the shoes into their natural environment: a private guided Zion trail run/walk/hike. Move at your speed.

In the afternoon, we return to Sand Hollow, this time the Championship Course. Elevated tees, exposed ridgelines and cliffside greens. Desert golf at its most cinematic.

As night falls, we gather for a private long-table dinner by the fire under the stars. With Zion designated as part of Utah’s International Dark Sky landscape, we’ll close the evening with stargazing beneath one of the clearest night skies in North America.

Day Three

Coffee and breakfast.

Our final round takes place at Copper Rock Golf Club’s bold red rock backdrops and wide fairways framed by black lava and desert brush.

One last walk before goodbyes & hugs

Your Ticket Includes

• Two nights accommodation in our remote Zion camp - personal glamping accommodations (no shared rooms)

• Two rounds at Sand Hollow (Links & Championship Courses)

• Final round at Copper Rock Golf Club

• Exclusive GGNC x ON duffle bag & curated gear worth over $1000

• Unreleased ON trail sneakers

• Private mobility & breathwork session powered by ON

• Guided Zion trail run / walk / hike with ON performance expert

• BBQ dinner & drinks on arrival night

• Private long-table dinner under the stars by local chef on night 2

• Stargazing experience in Utah’s International Dark Sky region

• Entry & transport to Zion Hot Springs

• Transport between golf, park and camp locations throughout the trip

What You Handle

• Travel to and from St. George, Utah

• Personal golf gear (club rentals can be arranged)

• Any specialty photography or trail gear you’d like to bring
